prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: hit while turning left. Injury: whiplash. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1009; do not mention it.)
text:
We write to present the bodily injury claim of our client, [CLIENT_NAME], arising from the collision of [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was making a left turn at an intersection when your insured's vehicle struck the driver's side of her car. The impact was forceful enough to deploy the airbag and cause her head to snap forward and back, resulting in a diagnosis of whiplash injury to the neck and upper back.

Since the accident, our client has undergone physical therapy and has been treated by her primary care physician. She has experienced persistent neck stiffness, headaches, and reduced range of motion, which have interfered with her work and her ability to care for her family. Her medical records and treatment notes are enclosed for your review.

The liability picture is clear. Your insured failed to yield while approaching the intersection and had the opportunity to avoid the collision. Our client bore no responsibility for the crash.

Based on the medical evidence, the ongoing treatment, and the lost income documented in the enclosed materials, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve this claim in full. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we are prepared to file suit without further notice.
